decisions.reason: The quantified customer savings shown in 2023 provide early positive evidence of value, and for a growing German recycling-machinery firm this makes continued commercialization of this modular concept a low-regret option.

As a new 2023 launch close to the firm's core range and important enough to receive its own page, it should be kept because uncertainty is still resolving and the firm can afford to hold this option while learning from the market.

Although evidence is still limited, this modular waste-processing concept builds directly on established capabilities, so the cost of keeping the option open for another period is likely modest relative to its potential strategic fit.

The mobile trommel screen is close to the existing offer and there is no clear negative signal yet, so real-options logic favors retaining it in 2024 to gather more market information before abandoning it.
